title: Retained report metadata discovery selector for AOP-005
description: Closed metadata-only discovery of retained package detection and package-zone report handles. The launcher fixes deployment/principal. The immutable reader verifies the complete bounded current declaration index, exact native publication manifests and retained metadata/report bytes before filtering and pagination, then revalidates under the same allowance. Existing AgentResponseEnvelope and AgentCognitiveEnvelope query/case contracts preserve protected deployment context. Returned handles establish metadata custody only: original source availability, current source reconstruction, privacy eligibility for coordinates and QSR eligibility remain unestablished. No ReadMedia grant, original-media read, model execution, recovery, publication or effect is inferred. The complete protected page fits 256 KiB or refuses. Native admission remains authoritative.

family.description: Exact existing cognition family; omission selects both. Detector rows expose the original package-detection report digest accepted by tracks queries. Zone rows retain v1 versus v2 metadata identity; discovery does not certify QSR eligibility.

from_ns.description: Optional inclusive lower endpoint as a canonical i128 decimal string. Selects closed overlap with the declaration's source-native validity interval. No UTC conversion, cross-source clock alignment or physical timing claim.

through_ns.description: Optional inclusive upper endpoint as a canonical i128 decimal string. Native admission requires from_ns <= through_ns when both are supplied.

max_entries.description: Complete report metadata handles per page, in native family then report-digest order.

anchor.description: Optional exact current deployment authority/effect-history precondition. Historical report declarations do not select historical authority.

continuation.description: Exact native continuation from the preceding page, bound to principal, filters, page size, complete verified index, all limits and the current authority/effect prefix. No offset, discovery bypass or silent rebase.

max_query_read_bytes.description: Shared metadata payload-byte ceiling, 1..268435456, covering current history, native manifests, retained records/reports and final rereads. Original source media is not read; failed reads invalidate the remaining balance.

max_query_read_objects.description: Shared metadata payload-read-attempt ceiling, 1..65536, including final revalidation. Not an archive filesystem syscall quota.

max_query_results.description: Complete supported-family report-index ceiling, 1..4096, applied before family/time filtering and pagination. A smaller filter never bypasses verification or truncates an over-budget index. Native traversal separately admits at most 65536 ledger objects and committed batches.
